text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see Jake of the Followers.
source_text: You see Jake of the Followers.

text: 你看见末世论者信徒杰克。
source_text: 你看见末世论者信徒杰克。

text: You see a Follower of the Apocalypse.
source_text: You see a Follower of the Apocalypse.

text: 你看见末世论者的一名信徒。
source_text: 你看见末世论者的一名信徒。

text: Welcome, my friend! How might I help you today?
source_text: Welcome, my friend! How might I help you today?

text: 欢迎，我的朋友！你想要什么？
source_text: 欢迎，我的朋友！你想要什么？

text: Me hep! Me hep!
source_text: Me hep! Me hep!

text: 我帮！我帮！
source_text: 我帮！我帮！

text: I heard that you are a decent fighter. Let's find out.
source_text: I heard that you are a decent fighter. Let's find out.

text: 我听说你是个很好的战士，我来会会你。
source_text: 我听说你是个很好的战士，我来会会你。

text: I hear you need help. What's the problem?
source_text: I hear you need help. What's the problem?

text: 听说你们需要帮忙。有什么麻烦事？
source_text: 听说你们需要帮忙。有什么麻烦事？

text: What can you tell me about the Followers?
source_text: What can you tell me about the Followers?

text: 你能说说末世论者信徒的事情吗？
source_text: 你能说说末世论者信徒的事情吗？

text: You want to help. I don't think you are good enough to# help me out. Go talk to Neil.
source_text:
You want to help. I don't think you are good enough to
# help me out. Go talk to Neil.

text: 你来帮忙？我觉得你还不够像样啊。和尼尔聊聊去吧。
source_text: 你来帮忙？我觉得你还不够像样啊。和尼尔聊聊去吧。

text: I would love to fight you, but I am much too busy helping# Nicole right now.
source_text:
I would love to fight you, but I am much too busy helping
# Nicole right now.

text: 我也想和你来一架，但是我还要帮妮可尔做很多事情。
source_text: 我也想和你来一架，但是我还要帮妮可尔做很多事情。

text: Figures. You looked like a wimp to me anyways.
source_text: Figures. You looked like a wimp to me anyways.

text: 没错，你看起来就是一个垃圾啊。
source_text: 没错，你看起来就是一个垃圾啊。

text: Suit yourself. Good bye.
source_text: Suit yourself. Good bye.

text: 随你了，再见。
source_text: 随你了，再见。

text: How did a wimp like you become second in command?
source_text: How did a wimp like you become second in command?

text: 你这样一个垃圾怎么能当了二把手呢？
source_text: 你这样一个垃圾怎么能当了二把手呢？

text: Hey. Just because I don't want to fight doesn't mean I'm a# wimp. I just don't feel like it.
source_text:
Hey. Just because I don't want to fight doesn't mean I'm a
# wimp. I just don't feel like it.

text: 嘿，我不想和你打不代表我就怕了你，我现在没心情。
source_text: 嘿，我不想和你打不代表我就怕了你，我现在没心情。

text: I was right. Just a wimp.
source_text: I was right. Just a wimp.

text: 我说的没错，你就是垃圾。
source_text: 我说的没错，你就是垃圾。

text: Some of us will use our brains to get further in this world.# A lot can be settled with peace and thinking.
source_text:
Some of us will use our brains to get further in this world.
# A lot can be settled with peace and thinking.

text: 有时候动动脑子能走得更远。和平和思考能解决很多事情。
source_text: 有时候动动脑子能走得更远。和平和思考能解决很多事情。

text: When are you going to use your brains then?
source_text: When are you going to use your brains then?

text: 那你要什么时候来动你的脑子呢？
source_text: 那你要什么时候来动你的脑子呢？

text: You're right. I'm sorry.
source_text: You're right. I'm sorry.

text: 你说的对，对不起。
source_text: 你说的对，对不起。

text: That's it. I'm not going to talk to you anymore.
source_text: That's it. I'm not going to talk to you anymore.

text: 算了，我不想和你说话了。
source_text: 算了，我不想和你说话了。

text: That's better. Now. I have a problem with a spy around here.# Will you help me?
source_text:
That's better. Now. I have a problem with a spy around here.
# Will you help me?

text: 这样就好。我现在要查一个间谍，你能帮我吗？
source_text: 这样就好。我现在要查一个间谍，你能帮我吗？

text: Yes. What is it?
source_text: Yes. What is it?

text: 好，怎么回事？
source_text: 好，怎么回事？

text: Fix it yourself if you are so great.
source_text: Fix it yourself if you are so great.

text: 如果你那么棒，你自己去办就是了。
source_text: 如果你那么棒，你自己去办就是了。

text: I just said we have a spy around here. I think it may be one# of the guards that is the spy. Though it could be a scout.# Those are the only two groups that have access to the# Children.
source_text:
I just said we have a spy around here. I think it may be one
# of the guards that is the spy. Though it could be a scout.
# Those are the only two groups that have access to the
# Children.

text: 我说了，附近有一个间谍。可能是卫士，也可能是哨兵。和大教堂联络的就这两种人。
source_text: 我说了，附近有一个间谍。可能是卫士，也可能是哨兵。和大教堂联络的就这两种人。

text: Okay. I'll go get your spy and eliminate the problem.
source_text: Okay. I'll go get your spy and eliminate the problem.

text: 好吧，我去找出那个间谍干掉。
source_text: 好吧，我去找出那个间谍干掉。

text: Have any leads on this spy?
source_text: Have any leads on this spy?

text: 有什么线索吗？
source_text: 有什么线索吗？

text: Forget it. I won't help you.
source_text: Forget it. I won't help you.

text: 算了，我不干了。
source_text: 算了，我不干了。

text: Thank you very much. Now go!
source_text: Thank you very much. Now go!

text: 那就多谢你了。走开！
source_text: 那就多谢你了。走开！

text: Nothing really. The only things I really know about is# that a lot of low level information is getting to the# Children. This is not good. Heather thinks it is either# Neil or Peter.
source_text:
Nothing really. The only things I really know about is
# that a lot of low level information is getting to the
# Children. This is not good. Heather thinks it is either
# Neil or Peter.

text: 没什么线索。我只知道很多低层次的机密已经泄露给了教堂，这不是什么好事，希瑟认为不是尼尔就是彼得。
source_text: 没什么线索。我只知道很多低层次的机密已经泄露给了教堂，这不是什么好事，希瑟认为不是尼尔就是彼得。

text: Okay. I will go check on it.
source_text: Okay. I will go check on it.

text: 好，我去查。
source_text: 好，我去查。

text: Forget it. I won't help you.
source_text: Forget it. I won't help you.

text: 算了，我帮不上你了。
source_text: 算了，我帮不上你了。

text: I can't let you leave then.
source_text: I can't let you leave then.

text: 那我也不能让你走。
source_text: 那我也不能让你走。

text: I will then. Good bye!
source_text: I will then. Good bye!

text: 那我就去办，再见。
source_text: 那我就去办，再见。

text: We are having trouble with some of our information# slipping out to the Children. I think it is a spy.
source_text:
We are having trouble with some of our information
# slipping out to the Children. I think it is a spy.

text: 我们的机密被泄露给了教堂，有间谍。
source_text: 我们的机密被泄露给了教堂，有间谍。

text: Okay. So, what is the problem?
source_text: Okay. So, what is the problem?

text: 好，有什么问题？
source_text: 好，有什么问题？

text: Okay, I'll deal with this spy.
source_text: Okay, I'll deal with this spy.

text: 好，我去查间谍。
source_text: 好，我去查间谍。

text: Have any leads yet?
source_text: Have any leads yet?

text: 有线索了没？
source_text: 有线索了没？

text: Forget it. I won't help you.
source_text: Forget it. I won't help you.

text: 算了，我帮不了你。
source_text: 算了，我帮不了你。

text: Currently, I can't tell you anything. Good day.
source_text: Currently, I can't tell you anything. Good day.

text: 目前，我还没什么发现。再见。
source_text: 目前，我还没什么发现。再见。

text: I am trying to sleep. Don't bother me.
source_text: I am trying to sleep. Don't bother me.

text: 我要睡觉，别吵我。
source_text: 我要睡觉，别吵我。

text: Hurry up and find that vile scum!
source_text: Hurry up and find that vile scum!

text: 快点，找到那个混蛋。
source_text: 快点，找到那个混蛋。

text: I knew it was Heather all along. She was deceitful from# the start. I should have told everyone what I thought at first.
source_text:
I knew it was Heather all along. She was deceitful from
# the start. I should have told everyone what I thought at first.

text: 我就知道是希瑟干的，她一开始就鬼头鬼脑的。我应该一开始就告诉其他人的。
source_text: 我就知道是希瑟干的，她一开始就鬼头鬼脑的。我应该一开始就告诉其他人的。

text: I never did learn anything from you. Your training# was useless.
source_text:
I never did learn anything from you. Your training
# was useless.

text: 我从你这里什么也没学到，你的训练毫无用处。
source_text: 我从你这里什么也没学到，你的训练毫无用处。

text: I have a package for you from Gabriel.
source_text: I have a package for you from Gabriel.

text: 我从加布里尔那里给你带来一个包裹。
source_text: 我从加布里尔那里给你带来一个包裹。

text: Hmm. I see. Thank you.
source_text: Hmm. I see. Thank you.

text: 哦，知道了，多谢。
source_text: 哦，知道了，多谢。

text: Get the hell out.
source_text: Get the hell out.

text: 走开。
source_text: 走开。

text: It's the hard way. It's always the hard way.
source_text: It's the hard way. It's always the hard way.

text: 很难，一直都很难。
source_text: 很难，一直都很难。
